nodes.en: Source databases: schema, keys, query history
nodes.zh: 源数据库：表结构、键、查询历史

nodes.en: Each pass picks only tables without a term yet
nodes.zh: 每轮编译只挑还没有术语的表

nodes.en: Sample up to 1,000 rows; model names terms
nodes.zh: 每表最多抽 1000 行；模型命名术语

nodes.en: Inferred join kept only if values match and the join returns a row
nodes.zh: 推断的连接要值能对上、实际连接有结果才保留

nodes.en: Ontology in Postgres + pgvector; people edit and certify
nodes.zh: 本体存在 Postgres + pgvector；人工修改和认证

nodes.en: Model endpoints: NVIDIA API by default
nodes.zh: 模型端点：默认 NVIDIA 托管 API

nodes.en: check_answerable: share of question entities the ontology covers
nodes.zh: check_answerable：问题里的实体有多少被本体覆盖

nodes.en: sqlglot check: one read query, known names, tables retrieve showed
nodes.zh: sqlglot 检查：单条只读查询、名字都在目录里、表都由 retrieve 展示过

nodes.en: Answer with its SQL and steps, or a refusal
nodes.zh: 带 SQL 和步骤的回答，或拒答

edges.en: edited terms are skipped next time
edges.zh: 改过的术语下轮不再重编
未知名字及最接近的真名
